item.title: 黑色星期五将于下周在 OpenMarket 上推出，最高可享受 60% 的折扣。这是我们一年中唯
item.description:
黑色星期五将于下周在 OpenMarket 上推出，最高可享受 60% 的折扣。这是我们一年中唯一一次打折。

如果您选择选择计划，谢谢。您直接帮助我们和社区建立一个更好、更公平的图表生态系统来与巨头竞争。它直接带来更多数据、更多交换、更快的提要和更多功能。还有很多工作要做，您的支持可以帮助我们更快地实现目标。

如果您还不想付款，那也完全没问题。 OpenMarket 社区今年大幅增长，我们将继续尽我们所能提供更好的体验。社区越大，平台对每个人来说就越好（大数定律等等）。

对于那些已经使用包年套餐的用户，您已自动升级到我们新的 Max 套餐，限额全面提高 4 至 10 倍。

无论您是免费还是付费，未来 12 个月都会有更多惊喜。感谢您对我们的支持。

Black Friday is live on OpenMarket for the next week, up to 60% off. It's the only time of the year we do discounts.

If you choose to pick up a plan, thank you. You’re directly helping us and the community build a better, fairer charting ecosystem to compete with the giants. It goes straight into more data, more exchanges, faster feeds, and more features. There’s still a lot left to build, and your support helps us get there faster.

If you're not looking to pay yet, that’s totally fine too. The OpenMarket community has grown massively this year, and we’ll keep making the experience as good as we can. The bigger the community, the better the platform gets for everyone (law of large numbers and all that).

For those already on an annual plan, you’ve been automatically upgraded to our new Max plan with 4–10x higher limits across the board.

Expect a lot more over the next 12 months, whether you’re free or paying. Thanks for supporting us.

item.title: 我们还改进了您阅读交易流的方式。 • Big Trades 的外观更简洁，样式更多，定制方式也
item.description:
我们还改进了您阅读交易流的方式。

• Big Trades 的外观更简洁，样式更多，定制方式也更多

• 磁带仍显示每次交换的原始流。您现在还可以按时间（从 1 秒到 1 分钟）对其进行分组，以查看交易量集中在哪里以及不平衡如何变化

• 暗池和选项打印现在可以追溯到更远的地方并显示更多尺寸：打印从 10 万美元起，最多可回溯 90 天

We've also improved how you read the trade stream.

• Big Trades has a cleaner look, with more styles and more ways to customise it

• The tape still shows the raw stream from every exchange. You can now also group it by time, from 1s to 1m, to see where volume concentrates and how imbalances shift

• Dark pool and option prints now reach further back and show more sizes: prints from $100K, up to 90 days back

item.title: 我们还增强了聚合足迹，因此您可以细分每个价格的交易量。 • 按蜡烛中的时间：查看某
item.description:
我们还增强了聚合足迹，因此您可以细分每个价格的交易量。

• 按蜡烛中的时间：查看某个水平是早交易还是晚交易
• 通过交换：查看哪个地点推动了这一举动
• 按现货和永续收益：查看是真实买入还是杠杆买入

当您使用该应用程序时，您还会发现许多较小的设计改进。

所有这些对所有用户都是免费的。这就是今天的全部内容，稍后会更！

We've also enhanced aggregated footprints, so you can break down the volume at each price.

• By time in the candle: see whether a level traded early or late
• By exchange: see which venue drove the move
• By spot and perps: see whether it was real buying or leverage

You'll also find plenty of smaller design improvements as you use the app.

All of it is free for all users. That's all for today, more soon!

item.title: 从今天开始，OpenMarket 将逐笔传输来自每个交易所、暗池和批发商的每笔美国股票交易
item.description:
从今天开始，OpenMarket 将逐笔传输来自每个交易所、暗池和批发商的每笔美国股票交易。

TradingView 没有胶带，零暗池打印，并且可以根据蜡烛颜色猜测订单流。我们从每笔交易中计算它。

现在每个人都可以看到：
→ 完整的磁带。每只美国上市股票和 ETF 的每笔交易，无论明市还是暗市，从盘前到盘后
→ 根据实际填充构建的足迹、CVD 和增量
→ 买卖热图显示当天的交易量
→ 暗池印刷品按其确切价格绘制
→ 超过 100 万美元的期权横扫股市
→ 同一张图表上的 GEX 热图、交易商定位和隐含波动率

目前，美国近一半的股票交易量是在场外交易的。如果你的图表只显示活跃的交易所，那么你就看到了一半的市场。

Starting today, OpenMarket streams every US stock trade, tick by tick, from every exchange, dark pool and wholesaler.

TradingView has no tape, zero dark pool prints, and order flow guessed from candle color. We calculate it from every trade.

What everyone can now see:
→ The full tape. Every trade in every US-listed stock and ETF, lit and dark, premarket to after hours
→ Footprint, CVD and delta built from actual fills
→ Buy and sell heatmaps showing where the day's volume traded
→ Dark pool prints plotted at their exact price
→ $1M+ options blocks and sweeps beside the stock tape
→ GEX heatmaps, dealer positioning and implied volatility on the same chart

Nearly half of US stock volume now trades off-exchange. If your chart only shows lit exchanges, you're seeing half the market.
